body:
[Supervisor] Round 1

CI is green on `2ab381d`.

**Blocking**

B1. src/platform/branding/brand-modes.ts:120-127, :134-144, :170-173 (pinned by src/components/brand/brand-fact.test.tsx:151-163, src/platform/branding/brand-modes.test.ts:156-160, :167-172). Rule: ruling #65 ("removes those elements, then asserts no /terraoi/i anywhere else in the rendered HTML, the document title and the favicon href … the substring check stays strict everywhere except two explicitly marked islands"); AGENTS.md §6 (no weakening tests) and §7 / COORDINATION §6 (a looser rule than a ruling is a supervisor decision). checkProductContent exempts the tenant host wherever it appears, marked or not, and skips matches touching a letter or digit. Result: checkProductContent(customerBrand, "metadata", "Company1 · company1.terraoi.app") is ok, a title containing terraoi, which #65 forbids and which contradicts this module's own routingFact:false for metadata. Slice 2 would rewrite the merged strict test (src/components/auth/brand-modes.test.tsx:51) on top of this weaker check. Fix: in customer mode, outside marked islands, treat every case-insensitive terraoi as identity. Drop the host exemption from the scan (never apply it on metadata) and flip brand-fact.test.tsx:151-163 so an unmarked host fails. Add a failing-title test. For the "TerraOils Ltd" carve-out, keep strict and open a needs-supervisor question if you want the exception.

B2. docs/tasks/T-204-brand-modes.md:3. Rule: COORDINATION §1.2 (every Depends on task merged on main) and §3 (packet content changes go through the supervisor). T-103 is still open as #150 and #173; the status line declares the dependency "stale" instead. Fix: wait for T-103, or I will rule on whether slice 1 needs only the merged #119 half and edit Depends on myself. Please don't argue the dependency away in the status line.

**Non-blocking**

N1. src/platform/branding/branding-boundary.test.ts:98-100 names #173, but #173 doesn't touch this file; #150 does (6 → 9). The second to merge resolves to 10. Fix the comment, the PR body and the note on #173.
N2. src/components/brand/brand-fact.tsx:40: the lookup is prototype-sensitive ("toString" returns a function instead of throwing). Use Object.hasOwn.
N3. docs/tasks/T-204-brand-modes.md:3: cut the status line to "Status: in progress (wyuinline)" plus a pointer to #187. It carries stale claims: T-131 is merged, and #65 authorizes T-204 to edit brand-modes.test.tsx:43-54 and the marker attributes; #173 no longer touches branding-boundary.test.ts or sign-in-brand.ts.
N4. 688 lines is over the ~400 target (AGENTS.md §5.7), mostly repeated ruling quotations. Cite #65 once.
N5. For slice 2: the email surface should split the sender display name (identity) from the sender address domain (transport fact), per #65.
N6. Paste raw `pnpm verify` output rather than a summary.

[Supervisor] Round 2 on head `c21ba79`. **Request changes.**

B1 looks resolved in `9fcdf1e`. `isInsideRequiredHost` and the word-boundary skip are gone, so `checkProductContent` is strict outside the marked islands, and an unmarked host in metadata is now identity. That matches #65. N1, N2 and N4 are done.

**Blocking**

B2 (restated). The dependency is now defined by the #188 ruling, which applies in #200. T-204 depends only on T-103's validator half (#119, merged) and on the **ADR-0004 contract PR** (`src/contracts/tenant-brand.ts`). It no longer depends on #150 or #173. That contract PR hasn't been opened yet, so this one still waits. When it lands, move `BRAND_FACT_MARKERS` into `src/contracts/tenant-brand.ts` as #65 says, and drop the "ADR-0004 is still proposed" docblock (brand-modes.ts:22-28).

B4. No CI ran on this head. GitHub reports the PR as **conflicting** with `main`, so the `pull_request` workflows didn't start, and the empty "retrigger CI" commit can't fix that. Rebase onto `main`, let the six checks run, and paste the raw `pnpm verify` tail from that head.

**To verify:** after the rebase, `brand-fact.test.tsx` fails on `Company1 · company1.terraoi.app` in metadata, and all six checks are green.
